newsitem.title: GERMANY: TENNIS-SAMPRAS, CHANG AND MARTIN OUT OF GRAND SLAM CUP.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-SAMPRAS, CHANG AND MARTIN OUT OF GRAND SLAM CUP.

text.p: World number one Pete Sampras, Michael Chang and Todd Martin have all withdrawn injured from this week's season-ending Grand Slam Cup, the richest event in the tennis calendar, organisers said on Sunday.
The $6 million tournament, held in Munich, is intended to feature the 16 players who have the best record in the year's four Grand Slam events.
The organising committee said the three Americans would be replaced by Thomas Enqvist of Sweden, Jakob Hlasek of Switzerland and Tim Henman of Britain.
Henman will face German Michael Stich in Tuesday's opening match.
